description: This file is a CMake module script that defines a custom function `compile_aidl` used during build time to generate source code from AIDL files. It includes documentation embedded in comments that explain its purpose, usage, and options.

methods.name: compile_aidl
methods.description: Defines a CMake function to generate source files from AIDL files, allowing customization of the aidl compiler path, language, include directories, and output target directory.
